Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, Lord of the month of Ramadan
In which You revealed the Quran
And You made fasting obligatory upon Your servants

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And grant me the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House

Arabic text: فِيْ عَامِيْ هٰذَا وَفِيْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
Translation: In this year and in every year
And forgive me for those great sins
For no one can forgive them except You
